```{r}
#| label: load packages & fns
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(glue)
library(jsonlite)
library(knitr)
library(ivs)

source(here("analysis_scripts/annotation_overlap_fns.R"))
```

# Load data

```{r}
#| label: load data
all_annotations <- read_csv(here("data/all_annotations.csv"),
    col_types = cols(
        recording = col_character(),
        start = col_double(),
        stop = col_double(),
        label = col_character()
    )
)

all_predictions <- read_csv(
    here("data/all_predictions.csv"),
    col_types = cols(
        recording = col_character(),
        start = col_double(),
        stop = col_double(),
        label = col_character(),
        mean_p = col_double(),
        label_source = col_character()
    )
)
```

# Annotations & Predictions

```{r}
#| label: annotation duration
mean_annotation_duration <- all_annotations |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(
        duration = stop - start
    ) |>
    group_by(
        label
    ) |>
    summarize(
        ens = n(),
        min = min(duration),
        max = max(duration),
        mean = mean(duration),
        sd = sd(duration),
        se = sd / sqrt(ens),
        margin = qt(0.975, df = ens - 1) * se,
        ci95_lower = mean - margin,
        ci95_upper = mean + margin
    ) |>
    select(-margin)

kable(mean_annotation_duration, caption = "Duration of Annotations by Type", digits = 3)
```

```{r}
#| label: prediction duration
mean_prediction_duration <- all_predictions |>
    ungroup() |>
    mutate(
        duration = stop - start
    ) |>
    group_by(
        label
    ) |>
    summarize(
        ens = n(),
        min = min(duration),
        max = max(duration),
        mean = mean(duration),
        sd = sd(duration),
        se = sd / sqrt(ens),
        margin = qt(0.975, df = ens - 1) * se,
        ci95_lower = mean - margin,
        ci95_upper = mean + margin
    ) |>
    select(-margin)
kable(mean_prediction_duration, caption = "Duration of Predictions by Type", digits = 3)
```

# Overlaps
```{r}
#| label: count overlaps
#| cache: true
all_annotations_overlaps <- all_annotations |>
    group_by(recording) |>
    arrange(start, .by_group = TRUE) |>
    mutate(
        count_overlaps(start, stop)
    )
write_csv(
    all_annotations_overlaps |>
        select(-overlaps_with_list),
    here("analysis_scripts", "output", "csv", "all_annotations_overlaps.csv")
)

all_predictions_overlaps <- all_predictions |>
    group_by(recording) |>
    arrange(start, .by_group = TRUE) |>
    mutate(
        count_overlaps(start, stop)
    )
write_csv(
    all_predictions_overlaps |>
        select(-overlaps_with_list),
    here("analysis_scripts", "output", "csv", "all_predictions_overlaps.csv")
)

```

```{r}
#| label: annotations overlap summary
all_annotations_overlaps_summary <- all_annotations_overlaps |>
    ungroup() |>
    select(-overlaps_with) |>
    count(overlaps_with_n) |>
    mutate(
        total = sum(n),
        percent = 100 * (n / sum(n))
    )

write_csv(
    all_annotations_overlaps_summary,
    here("analysis_scripts", "output", "csv", "all_annotations_overlaps_summary.csv")
)

kable(all_annotations_overlaps_summary, caption = "Annotations: Summary of Overlaps")
```

```{r}
#| label: predictions overlap summary
all_predictions_overlaps_summary <- all_predictions_overlaps |>
    ungroup() |>
    select(-overlaps_with) |>
    count(overlaps_with_n) |>
    mutate(
        total = sum(n),
        percent = 100 * (n / sum(n))
    )

write_csv(
    all_predictions_overlaps_summary,
    here("analysis_scripts", "output", "csv", "all_predictions_overlaps_summary.csv")
)

kable(all_predictions_overlaps_summary, caption = "Predictions: Summary of Overlaps")
```

```{r}
#| label: annotation overlap duration
all_annotations_overlaps_duration <- all_annotations |>
    group_by(recording) |>
    summarise(
        annotation_duration = sum(stop - start),
        overlap_duration = recording_overlap_duration(start, stop),
        ratio = overlap_duration / annotation_duration
    )

write_csv(
    all_annotations_overlaps_duration,
    here("analysis_scripts", "output", "csv", "all_annotations_overlaps_duration.csv")
)

all_annotations_overlaps_duration_summary <- all_annotations_overlaps_duration |>
    summarize(
        total_annotation_duration = sum(annotation_duration),
        total_overlap_duration = sum(all_annotations_overlaps_duration$overlap_duration),
        ratio_with_overlap = total_overlap_duration / total_annotation_duration
    )

write_csv(
    all_annotations_overlaps_duration_summary,
    here("analysis_scripts", "output", "csv", "all_annotations_overlaps_duration_summary.csv")
)

kable(all_annotations_overlaps_duration_summary, caption = "Annotations: Total overlap duration")
```

```{r}
#| label: annotation overlap duration figure
#| fig-cap: "Distribution of overlap duration in annotations"

ggplot(
    data = all_annotations_overlaps_duration,
    mapping = aes(x = overlap_duration)
) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth = 1) +
    labs(x = "total duration with overlap [s]") +
    theme_bw()
```

```{r}
#| label: prediction overlap duration
all_predictions_overlaps_duration <- all_predictions |>
    group_by(recording) |>
    summarise(
        prediction_duration = sum(stop - start),
        overlap_duration = recording_overlap_duration(start, stop),
        ratio = overlap_duration / prediction_duration
    )

write_csv(
    all_predictions_overlaps_duration,
    here("analysis_scripts", "output", "csv", "all_predictions_overlaps_duration.csv")
)

all_predictions_overlaps_duration_summary <- all_predictions_overlaps_duration |>
    summarize(
        total_prediction_duration = sum(prediction_duration),
        total_overlap_duration = sum(all_predictions_overlaps_duration$overlap_duration),
        ratio_with_overlap = total_overlap_duration / total_prediction_duration
    )

write_csv(
    all_predictions_overlaps_duration_summary,
    here("analysis_scripts", "output", "csv", "all_predictions_overlaps_duration_summary.csv")
)

kable(all_predictions_overlaps_duration_summary, caption = "Predictions: Total overlap duration")
```

```{r}
#| label: prediction overlap duration figure
#| fig-cap: "Distribution of overlap duration in predictions"

ggplot(
    data = all_predictions_overlaps_duration,
    mapping = aes(x = overlap_duration)
) +
    geom_histogram(binwidth = 1) +
    labs(x = "total duration with overlap [s]") +
    theme_bw()
```
